subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate direct form of the given sentence.**

She enquired if all those potatoes were to be peeled for dinner.

options.text: She said, “Should I peel all these potatoes for dinner?”
She said, “All those potatoes were to be peeled for dinner?”
She said, “Are all these potatoes to be peeled for dinner?”
She said, “Are all those potatoes peeling for dinner?”

solution:
The correct answer is **She said, “Are all these potatoes to be peeled for dinner?”** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Indirect Speech. As per the question, we have to change it into Direct Speech. 
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
 
• 'enquired' will be changed into '**said**' because the given question is an example of **an interrogative sentence** that starts with **a helping verb. **
 
• Comma and inverted commas will be added.
 
• The **conjunction** '**if**' will be removed.
 
• And the helping verb **'were to be peeled'** will be changed into **'are to be peeled'.**
 
• **'those' **will be changed into** 'these'.**
 
• Lastly, the **question mark **will be used.

 
 
 

**Correct Sentence:__** *She said, “Are all these potatoes to be peeled for dinner?”*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

__
 
• दिया गया वाक्य **Indirect Speech** में है। प्रश्न के अनुसार हमें इसे **Direct Speech **में बदलना होगा।
 
• परिवर्तन की प्रक्रिया इस प्रकार है:
 
 
• '**enquired**' को '**said**' में बदल दिया जाएगा क्योंकि दिया गया प्रश्न एक **interrogative sentence** का उदाहरण है जो **helping verb **से शुरू होता है।
 
• अल्पविराम और उल्टे अल्पविराम जोड़े जाएंगे।
 
• **Conjunction** '**if**' हटा दिया जाएगा।
 
• और **helping verb 'were to be peeled'** को **'are to be peeled' **में बदल दिया जाएगा।
 
• **'those'** को** 'these' **में बदल दिया जाएगा।
 
• अंत में,** प्रश्न चिह्न **का उपयोग किया जाएगा।
